data.name: Rishan
data.gender_notes: Rishan is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Bringer of happiness and joy, originating from the word rashan meaning 'joyful'. The name Rishan carries the meaning “Joyful” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Pashto. Parents who choose Rishan usually hope their child will grow to embody joyful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the joy and happiness that comes from following the path of righteousness and living a pure life, as described in the Quran.
data.etymology: Rishan belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Joyful.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rishan total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: ريشان
in_arabic.meaning: ريشان تعني الشخص الذي يمتلك القلب الكبير والشخصية القوية
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم ريشان مشتق من الجذر العربي 'ر-ش-ن' والذي يعني الرزانة والهدوء. يعتبر اسم ريشان من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني جميلة وقيم عالية، حيث يوصف الشخص الحامل لهذا الاسم بأنه شخص ذو قلب كبير وشخصية قوية، يتميز بالرزانة والهدوء في تصرفاته وأفعاله. وقد وردت هذه المعاني في القرآن الكريم في عدة مواضع، منها قول الله تعالى: 'وَرَشَنَ الْقَومُ أَيْ كَفَوا' (سورة يوسف، الآية ١٠٦).

in_urdu.name: ریشان
in_urdu.meaning: ریشان کا مطلب ہے بڑے دل اور مضبوط شخصیت کا حامل
in_urdu.long_meaning: ریشان نام عربی جڑ 'ر-ش-ن' سے نکلا ہے جس کا مطلب ہے رزانہ اور دھیما. مسلم روایت میں ریشان نام کے حامل کو بڑے دل اور مضبوط شخصیت کے ساتھ خوش اخلاق اور متوازن شخص کے طور پر بیان کیا گیا ہے. یہ نام قرآن مجید میں بھی آیا ہے، جیسے کہ سورہ یوسف میں: 'وَرَشَنَ الْقَومُ أَيْ كَفَوا' (سورہ یوسف، آیت ١٠٦).

in_hindi.name: रीशान
in_hindi.meaning: रीशान का अर्थ है बड़े दिल और मजबूत व्यक्तित्व वाला
in_hindi.long_meaning: रीशान नाम की उत्पत्ति 'र-श-न' अरबी मूल से हुई है, जिसका अर्थ है शांत और गंभीर. इस्लामी परंपरा में रिशान नाम के व्यक्ति को बड़े दिल, मजबूत व्यक्तित्व और शांत स्वभाव के साथ वर्णित किया गया है. यह नाम कुरआन में भी उल्लेखित है, जैसे सूरह यूसुफ में: 'وَرَشَنَ الْقَومُ أَيْ كَفَوا' (सूरह यूसुफ, आयत १०६).

in_pashto.name: ریشان
in_pashto.meaning: ریشان د لوی زړه او پیاوړي شخصیت خاوند دی
in_pashto.long_meaning: ریشان نوم د عربي ريښې 'ر-ش-ن' څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې معنی یې ده ارام او ډاډمن. په افغان او پښتني دود کې ریشان نوم د هغه چا لپاره کارول کیږي چې لوی زړه، پیاوړی شخصیت او ارام غوښتونکی وي. دا نوم په قرآن کریم کې هم راغلی دی، لکه د سورت یوسف په آیت ١٠٦ کې: 'وَرَشَنَ الْقَومُ أَيْ كَفَوا'.

in_english.name: Rishan
in_english.meaning: Rishan means the person with a large heart and strong personality
in_english.long_meaning: The name Rishan is derived from the Arabic root 'ر-ش-ن' (R-Sh-N), which means calmness and serenity. In Islamic tradition, Rishan is described as a person with a large heart, strong personality, and calm demeanor. This name is mentioned in the Quran, such as in Surah Yusuf: 'وَرَشَنَ الْقَومُ أَيْ كَفَوا' (Surah Yusuf, verse 106). The name Rishan signifies a person with a noble character, wisdom, and spiritual growth.

data.cultural_impact: The name Rishan signifies a happy and joyful spirit, which is a sought-after trait in many cultures. It reflects positivity and a cheerful disposition, making it an excellent choice for those who wish to evoke feel-good emotions and spread happiness.
data.spiritual_significance: In the Islamic context, the name Rishan holds a deeper spiritual significance. It is believed that by carrying this name, one is reminded to constantly seek joy and happiness in their faith and deen (way of life). The Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) once said, "Allah is pleased with a servant so long as he is pleased with what Allah has put in his sustenance and with the believer's attachment to the mosque." (Bukhari and Muslim). Therefore, Rishan can also mean one who finds happiness in pleasing Allah through righteous actions and a strong connection to their faith. Additionally, the name is said to have a connection to the Arabic word rahmah, meaning mercy and compassion, thus reminding the bearer to show kindness and compassion towards others.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Joyful" symbolizes Bringer of happiness and joy, originating from the word rashan meaning 'joyful'. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Rishan serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of joyful.
